### Look for an Advantage
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/look-for-an-advantage
Passage: Ecclesiastes 3:19-22
Points:
- Injustices and painful past events cannot be changed or erased.
- Believers must actively reject self-pity, resentment, and retaliation.
- Wisdom calls us to accept our lot and choose contentment in our daily activities.
- Reframing disadvantages from God's perspective allows our positive response to impact others.

### The Common End of Man and Beast
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/common-end-man-and-beast
Passage: Ecclesiastes 3:18-22
Points:
- The delay in divine judgment reminds humans that they are dependent creatures, not the sovereign Judge.
- Both humans and animals share physical mortality, originating from dust and returning to dust.
- Recognizing our temporary physical nature keeps us humble and brings healthy perspective to successes and failures.
- Because earthly life is brief, believers should gratefully receive and enjoy God's good gifts today.
